integrity: Local edge probabilities are independently reconstructed from the transfer-current kernel on the complete graph. The covariance is identified with a line-graph Laplacian and the grounded inverse is derived from an explicit pseudoinverse calculation. Exact Prüfer enumeration and rational matrix multiplication replay the finite identities but do not substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The host graph is complete; general uniform-spanning-tree covariance matrices need not have this two-orbit line-graph form.
Because the full indicator vector has deterministic total size, partial correlations are defined only after deleting one redundant edge coordinate.
Grounded Laplacian inverse positivity is classical; the claimed contribution is the exact Cayley-tree covariance identification, six precision classes, and residual-correlation formulas.
title: Grounded precision geometry of uniform Cayley-tree edge indicators
